description: This file contains unit tests for the FileBasedTenantService class within the org.eclipse.hono.deviceregistry package. It verifies behaviors like startup file creation, handling malformed JSON, loading tenants from file, and conversion utilities.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FileBasedTenantService, verifying its startup behavior, tenant data management, and data conversion utilities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and sets up the test fixture before each test.

methods.name: getTenantService
methods.description: Returns the tenant service instance under test.

methods.name: getTenantManagementService
methods.description: Returns the tenant management service instance under test.

methods.name: testDoStartCreatesFile
methods.description: Verifies that the service creates a file if it does not exist during startup.

methods.name: testDoStartFailsIfFileCannotBeCreated
methods.description: Checks startup failure when the service cannot create the necessary file.

methods.name: testDoStartIgnoresMalformedJson
methods.description: Ensures startup proceeds even if the tenant file contains malformed JSON.

methods.name: testDoStartLoadsTenants
methods.description: Verifies tenants are loaded correctly from the file during startup.

methods.name: testDoStartWithStartEmptyIgnoreTenants
methods.description: Checks that no tenants are loaded if startEmpty flag is set.

methods.name: testLoadTenantsCanReadOutputOfSaveToFile
methods.description: Validates that tenants can be saved to and loaded back from the file, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: testAddTenantSucceedsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that adding tenants succeeds when modification is not enabled.

methods.name: testRemoveTenantsFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Checks that removing tenants is forbidden when modification is disabled.

methods.name: testUpdateTenantsFailsIfModificationIsDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that updating tenants is forbidden when modification is disabled.

methods.name: testConversion
methods.description: Tests the conversion utility that transforms Tenant objects into JSON representation, including tracing configs and trust authorities.
